[[File:Barsenthor_Defender.png|thumb|right|300px|[[The Barsen'thor's Defender-class light corvette|The Barsen'thor's ''Defender''-class light corvette]]]]
A '''light corvette''' was a classification of [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

Modelled after the larger [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]], the [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|''Defender''-class light corvette]] was designed by the [[Rendili Vehicle Corporation/Legends|Rendili Vehicle Corporation]] for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="TORE" />

[[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] later, [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]] designed the [[Imperial Customs Corvette]], a class of light corvette.<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref>
